Located within the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]], the [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] known as '''Kharmort's Miasma''' was the site of<ref name="TUR" /> the [[Vagar Praxut system/Legends|Vagar Praxut system]]. The [[Star system/Legends|star system]] contained<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vagar Praxut]], [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Vagaari/Legends|Vagaari]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="TUR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kharmort's Miasma was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square H-9.<ref name="TEA" />
